name: Aroon(25) emerging trend: Aroon-Up crosses Aroon-Down, >50, then 100
author: Tushar Chande (StockCharts indicator page)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
entry_long: Up-trend signal: Aroon-Up crosses above Aroon-Down, then Aroon-Up > 50 and Aroon-Down < 50, then Aroon-Up reaches 100 with Aroon-Down low.
entry_short: Mirror: Aroon-Down crosses above Aroon-Up, >50, reaches 100.
exit: Trend ends when Aroon-Down crosses above Aroon-Up, exceeds 50 and rises to 100 (example) - signals reversal.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Three-stage description; entry timing at stage 1 vs 3 is user choice.
